page.layout: One page of index in two columns, under a centred heading "INDEX." at the top; "FINIS." centred below the columns. Left column: entries from Unberend to Whohoze. Right column: entries from Whozish to Zany. Show-through and stains at the lower part are not transcribed.
page.notes: Several page numbers are underlined or in blue/coloured type as cross-references; the Y-entry at "Yet" and some "Y/W" letterforms are uncertain. Entries from the left column: "wheele" carries two references (265, 292). Lower part of the page has heavy show-through, omitted. Some letters in the Old English black-letter style (w, th, y) were transcribed by their modern equivalents, e.g. "Yeare", "Yawle", "Zany"; the printed forms may differ.
